case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2023 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NOS. 25714-17 OF 2019)

parties.petitioner: The Registrar General, High Court of Karnataka & Anr.

summary: Judicial misconduct charges against Civil Judge; proved charges: unauthorized text substitution, improper bail grant in forest offense cases, false judgment entries; not proved: witness examination negligence, warrant misuse; disciplinary proceedings validity; High Court reversal improper; standard: preponderance of evidence; dismissal penalty sustained; intra-court appeal limitations.
final_judgment: Civil appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; dismissal from service reinstated; no bar on future departmental proceedings.
